authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.observation: EED items 10 through 13 map to DXF 1010 through 1013 and contain three double-precision XYZ coordinates.

construction: LibreDWG 0.14 generates locally authored R13/R14 controls with four distinct 3D EED points, remapped graph and one 3D LINE member. LibreDWG JSON readback verifies source values and graph. Generated drawings remain outside the repository.
checks: The shared legacy dictionary observer matches each finite coordinate bit-for-bit to the corresponding source span and requires the span to end exactly.
The ASan source control checks every source bit, all frame truncations, altered point values, matching-wire NaN refusal and corrected retry.
Group, NOD and MLINESTYLE owner profiles exercise R14 strict and R13 explicit-partial ASCII/Binary output with mutation refusal, destination preservation and corrected retry.
Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 readback verifies each point code and XYZ value and the GROUP-to-LINE graph for both output encodings, all three locations and both source versions.
limits: R13 output remains explicit partial; MLINESTYLE source semantics, native cloning and general DWG/DXF support remain unqualified.
This verifies selected finite point transport and does not establish application-specific transformation semantics or unobserved EED codes.
